Method.name: OnInit
Method.Implementation:
do ##super()
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("OnInit in NdmeHttpsJson ") set jsonData ="{}"
set jsonReq = ##class(%DynamicObject).%New() set jsonReq = ##class(%DynamicObject).%FromJSON(jsonData) Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() Set httprequest.Server = ..Adapter.HTTPServer Set httprequest.Port = ..Adapter.HTTPPort Set httprequest.Location = ..Adapter.URL Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig
Set httprequest.Https="1" Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" Set pstatus=##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).GetItemSettingValue("Op-CernEdge-Wsrc-Sched-NDME","AuthToken",.configValue) $$$TRACE("Status:"_pstatus) Set authToken=configValue do httprequest.SetHeader("ITX-AUTHORIZATION",authToken)
Do httprequest.EntityBody.Write(jsonData) // ---> data try { Set writer=##class(%Net.MIMEWriter).%New() Set status=writer.OutputToStream(httprequest.EntityBody) set postStatus = httprequest.Post(,2) set len = httprequest.HttpResponse.ContentLength set respData = httprequest.HttpResponse.Data.Read() $$$TRACE("Resp Status: "_postStatus) $$$TRACE("Resp Data: "_respData) set postStatus =$E(postStatus,1,1) if (postStatus = "0" ){ $$$TRACE(" NdmeHttpsJson ..Post Successful.") $$$TRACE("SUCCESS!!!..Ack received from NDME") set tSC = $$$OK }else{ set errTxt = " SKIP. ERROR!!!..NACK received from NDME" $$$TRACE("ERROR!!!..NACK received from NDME ") Set tSC = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).CheckError(..%ConfigName,errTxt) } } catch e { $$$TRACE(" Unknown Exception: " _ e) set errTxt = $System.Status.GetErrorText("Unknown Exception while calling NDME Https service. "_e) Set tSC = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).DisableMsgError(..%ConfigName,errTxt) } quit tSC
